notes.title: Chompania is here!
notes.content:
🚀 [b]Chompania is Now Live! [/b]🌌

We are delighted to reveal that "Chompania" is officially released and ready for you to dive into the cosmic wonders.

🌐 [b]Localization: Your Voice Matters![/b]

As part of our commitment to inclusivity, we've embraced AI-translator to bring "Chompania" to players worldwide. However, we understand the importance of precise language to truly immerse yourselves in the game. If you come across any localization quirks or have suggestions to enhance the experience in your language, we invite you to be a part of the game!

📝 [b]How You Can Contribute:[/b]

[list]
[*]Play the game in your preferred language.
[*]Identify any awkward phrasing or areas for improvement.
[*]Share your suggestions for more accurate translations (you can use the "Report a bug" button in the main menu).
[/list]

Your contributions will not only enhance the gaming experience for everyone but also possibly reserve you a spot in the credits.

🐞 Bug Reporting: Help Us Polish the Universe!

We value your input in making Chompania a seamless experience. If you encounter any glitches, anomalies, or quirky space-time phenomena, fear not! Simply head to the game's main menu and use the "Report a bug" button to submit the issue. Your detailed reports will assist us in fine-tuning the game and ensuring a smooth interstellar journey for all.

🌌 [b]Thank You for Joining the Quest![/b]

From the entire development team, thank you for being a part of this cosmic journey. May your voyages be filled with excitement, discovery, and endless possibilities.🌟

notes.title: Launching Date is Here
notes.content:
🌌 Join the Countdown!

Commanders and Explorers, mark your calendars and prepare your starships for the journey! "Chompania" will hit the gaming universe on January 6th, 2024. The countdown to explore uncharted territories and uncover the alien's secrets is now on!

🎉 Celebrate with Us!

We have planned a nice welcome discount for everyone to celebrate this momentous occasion. Don't miss it!

📆 Save the Date, Share the News!

As you could guess, we're a small indie studio that doesn't have a huge marketing budget. So we will send loads of gratitude to those who spread the word to fellow gamers, friends, and space enthusiasts about our game.

See you all on January 6th! 🚀

notes.title: Chompania Unveiling
notes.content:
🌌 [b]Hello and welcome to "Chompania"! 
[/b]
We are thrilled to announce the imminent launch of our indie game, a space 2D platformer that will take you on a stirring adventure through the quirky Chompania planet!✨

🚀 [b]Embark on a Journey![/b]

"Chompania" promises bright visuals and challenging puzzles that will test your skills in the vastness of space. Explore uncharted planet landscapes, encounter sassy alien species, and uncover the secrets of Chompania.

🌌 [b]Stay Tuned for Launch Day![/b]

Get ready to set sail among the stars! Keep an eye on our community page for the official release date. We can't wait for you to join us on this epic adventure.

Thank you for being a part of the community! 🌠

🌍 To make our game accessible to as many players as possible, we've utilized AI translators for some languages. However, we understand that language nuances are essential for an immersive gaming experience. If you come across any awkward phrasing, or cultural discrepancies, or if you have suggestions to enhance the narrative in your language, let us know! Your contributions will not only improve the game for everyone but also can reserve you a spot in credits 📝.
